definitions.explanation: A young person, especially a young man in their late teens to twenties.

examples.japanese: {青年|せいねん}⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Young people are playing active roles.

examples.japanese: {青年|せいねん}⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{暮|く}らした→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: I lived abroad during my youth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一|ひと}り→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{青年|せいねん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけてきた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: A young man spoke to me.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦では→では：02945_deha⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多く：18752_ooku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{青年|せいねん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{農業|のうぎょう}→農業：01491_nougyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}んでいる→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
examples.english: In this town, many young people are engaged in agriculture.

examples.japanese: {青年|せいねん}⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しか→しか：09959_shika⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦してほしい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want you to treasure the experiences that can only be had in your youth.

notes:
{青年|せいねん} typically refers to young adults, especially males.

AGE RANGE:
- Generally refers to late teens through twenties
- More commonly used for males

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {青年|せいねん}⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧ (youth, young days)
- {青年|せいねん}⟦{団|だん}→団：noentry⟧ (youth group)
- {青年|せいねん}⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦{協力|きょうりょく}→協力：00261_kyouryoku⟧⟦{隊|たい}→隊：noentry⟧ (Japan Overseas Cooperation Volunteers)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {青年|せいねん}: youth (formal, often male, late teens-20s)
- ⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧: young people (gender-neutral, casual)
- ⟦{少年|しょうねん}→少年：03238_shounen⟧: boy (younger, roughly 7-17)
